title: A local user with an ordinary account on the same host can place a file in a shared temporary location that the JDBC…
description: A local user with a standard account on the same host can place a file in a shared temporary location that the JDBC driver's native library loading routine will load without verifying the file's origin. This can lead to arbitrary code execution within the Java application process, potentially causing data disclosure, data alteration, or process unavailability.
